en.name: iCarDeal
en.subtitle: Car payment & budget planner
en.description:
CarDeal helps you work out what you can afford before you talk to anyone.

WHAT FITS YOUR BUDGET
Set the monthly payment you can manage, your down payment, the APR, sales tax and loan term, and see the most you can pay for a car. It also shows how much extra interest a longer term costs you.

FIND REAL LISTINGS
This version has no car listings of its own. It says so plainly and links you to AutoTrader and CarMax to search real inventory there.

No account is needed. Your settings are stored on your device.

CarDeal earns a commission on some outbound links to AutoTrader and CarMax.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
CarDeal helps you work out what you can afford before you talk to anyone.

Intended audience:
Car payment & budget planner

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. The app opens on the budget calculator ("What can I afford?"): set a monthly budget, down payment, APR, sales tax and loan term to see the most you can pay for a car and how much extra interest a longer term costs. The tab bar has two tabs, Budget and Settings. This build has no car listings of its own; the budget screen says so and links out to AutoTrader and CarMax search pages.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Firebase (Google) — app initialisation
- Firebase Crashlytics (Google) — crash reporting (crash data and a Crashlytics installation id; not linked to a user, no tracking)
- The Firebase Analytics and Performance Monitoring SDKs are linked through a shared library but are never started by the app and are switched off in Info.plist / AndroidManifest (FIREBASE_ANALYTICS_COLLECTION_DEACTIVATED, firebase_performance_collection_deactivated). Remote Config is not used.
- AutoTrader and CarMax — outbound links that open in the browser (affiliate referral parameters)

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app ships 12 languages (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish); the budget calculator, Settings and the tab bar are translated into all of them. Amounts are shown in US dollars. Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.

differentiation:
1. WHAT IT DOES
CarDeal is a car payment and budget calculator: it works out the most you can pay for a car from a monthly budget, down payment, APR, sales tax and loan term, and shows the extra interest a longer term costs.
Screens a user reaches in this build: budget, settings. The code also contains browse, search, saved, compare and detail screens, but they only appear in a build with a live inventory feed, and this build has none — it links out to AutoTrader and CarMax instead.

2. INTENDED USER
Someone about to buy a car who wants to know what they can afford before talking to a dealer.
